verdict.rationale: Penpot does not ship a built-in AI chat/assistant inside its own UI; instead it exposes an official self-hostable MCP server so external AI agents (Claude, etc.) can read/manipulate design files, and this was verified at runtime to work end-to-end (initialize handshake, tools capability). This lets an AI-native user delegate design tasks to an agent via Penpot, but requires bringing your own external agent/LLM client rather than a native in-app assistant. Missing for 10: a first-party in-product assistant UI/chat, evidence of task delegation happening natively inside the Penpot editor rather than through an external MCP client.
